response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS bpm FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), b AS (SELECT AVG(bpm) AS benchmark FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.bpm) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(m.bpm - b.benchmark) AS avg_diff_from_benchmark FROM m CROSS JOIN b WHERE m.bpm > b.benchmark

assumptions.assumption: A media type's bytes-per-millisecond figure is total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds across its tracks (ratio of sums), counting Milliseconds only for tracks with non-null Bytes.
The benchmark is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type figures; media types with no computable figure are ignored by the averages.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type's figure is the average of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios rather than the ratio of totals.
alternatives.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bpm FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), b AS (SELECT AVG(bpm) AS benchmark FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.bpm) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(m.bpm - b.benchmark) AS avg_diff_from_benchmark FROM m CROSS JOIN b WHERE m.bpm > b.benchmark
